cohort: The study included 4,768 women of reproductive age (15-49) in Tanzania, derived from the 2022 Tanzania Demographic Health and Survey (TDHS).
finding: The overall prevalence of Caesarean Section among women of reproductive age in Tanzania was 10.4%, with various socioeconomic and healthcare factors significantly associated with its occurrence.
mod_finding: The overall prevalence of Caesarean Section among women of reproductive age in Tanzania was 10.4%, with higher education, wealth, employment, and increased ANC visits associated with higher odds, while rural residence and higher parity were associated with lower odds of CS.
